Employee Kiosk Directory

Browse staff contact entries at each terminal in the building lobby. Every kiosk terminal displays a searchable roster of employee badge numbers, department assignments, and office locations for visitors who need to find a colleague quickly during business hours.

Facilities staff can refresh the kiosk directory listing from the terminal's maintenance panel without restarting the whole lobby display. The directory listing is synchronized nightly from the badge access system so newly onboarded employees appear the next morning at every terminal in the lobby network.

Visitors without a badge can still request a callback by selecting an employee entry on the terminal screen; the kiosk directory forwards the callback request to the receptionist station for that floor.
